items.title: Solana’s “million-payments-a-second” AI system can leave sellers unpaid even after they deliver
items.whyYouShouldCare: The potential for unpaid transactions in Solana's high-speed payment system could undermine trust and liquidity for users and developers within the ecosystem.

items.title: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades
items.whyYouShouldCare: Tripling transaction sizes on Solana enhances the platform's capacity for complex trades, potentially attracting more developers and increasing overall network usage.

items.title: TAO goes live on Raydium, price hits 3-month high: What’s next for Bittensor?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The launch of TAO on Raydium and its price surge could signal increased interest in Bittensor, impacting liquidity and trading dynamics within the Solana ecosystem.
